capabilities: generate summaries with configurable LLM providers and models
create structured notes with key points, technical terms, and video metadata
run summaries with custom per-call prompts
add custom OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible providers with custom endpoints
extras: The README documents token limits per provider and appends a warning to notes when summaries are truncated by the token limit; model pricing is displayed in the settings UI.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a YouTube video's transcript into an AI-generated summary note with key points and metadata.

relations.evidence: OpenRouter has been tested with this plugin using the endpoint URL
Grok has been tested using the endpoint URL

requires.name: Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, or OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible provider API key

summary: AI summarizer that extracts YouTube video transcripts and generates structured summary notes using Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, or compatible LLM providers.
